title: Per-Claim Limit Addition to the Extra-Guest Share — Listings Bands by HostCover Level
content:
# Per-Claim Limit Addition to the Extra-Guest Share

*Band table for Roamhaven Listings, read against the listing's Host Damage Protection (HostCover) plan.*

On top of the standard extra-guest share, a listing may carry a per-claim limit addition, worked out on the day of the extra-guest fee reset. It reads the per-claim limit — the most paid on one claim — of the HostCover level that the listing's active Host Damage Protection (HostCover) plan holds.

| Per-claim limit of the HostCover level on the listing's active plan | Added to the listing's extra-guest share |
|---|---|
| at most $5000.00 | 0.10 |
| above $5000.00 and at most $25000.00 | 0.05 |
| above $25000.00 | nothing |

## Band edges (hypothetical limits)

| Per-claim limit | Addition |
|---|---|
| $5000.00 | 0.10 — the edge belongs to the first band |
| $10000.00 | 0.05 |
| $25000.00 | 0.05 — the edge belongs to the second band |
| $50000.00 | nothing |
